status: Frozen final A completed; extraction recall gate FAILED. No rescoring, exclusions, reruns, parameter/corpus/rubric/production/evaluator changes performed by this audit.
reviewer: Separate read-only reviewer within the same Codex development team; not an external or fully independent blinded evaluation.

frozen_authoring.authoring: New synthetic sources and semantic gold authored after development by the same Codex author/team as implementation. This is not external or fully independent blinded evaluation. One explicitly marked known_anchor is a known development anchor.

frozen_scoring_note: Exactly 20 positives and 20 negatives. One positive is known_anchor; 39 sources are newly authored. Own-source evidence excludes every external voice. A preferences may autonomously promote only with valid own authority; B hardware/project claims require review. Every incorrect actor/origin candidate or active record is a critical write. Punctuation variants are literal source alternatives, not paraphrases.

curation.native_source_authority: Only descriptive author/subject/origin/range observations and hash-match booleans are reproduced. Opaque source/job IDs, claim digests and private lease data are omitted.

denominators.note: One real Gemma response per case is replayed into LLM and hybrid modes. Those modes are not separate stochastic model samples. The known anchor stays in every frozen denominator.

observed_failure_boundary.interpretation: The observed loss is after evidence nomination, at native eligibility/canonical acceptance. This does not by itself identify one internal parser branch. It is not missing evidence in the model output and not a posthoc span-rubric artifact.
observed_failure_boundary.ex015_saved_native_result: Ineligible V3 source; LLM/hybrid jobs failed with source_ineligible.
observed_failure_boundary.ex018_saved_native_result: not_eligible/ignored in all three modes; saved validation says Ineligible V3 source.
observed_failure_boundary.other_five_saved_native_results: Rules report not_eligible/ignored; LLM/hybrid jobs finish done with no accepted claims or records.

gold_and_policy_notes: The seven omitted positives are literal own declarations. Their nominal/possessive or fronted constructions do not make the author foreign or hypothetical. The frozen loss counts remain unchanged.
The afternoon qualifier in ex-001 restricts context but does not negate personal ownership. No record was produced, so there is no observed persisted temporal overgeneralization to excuse or rescore.
In ex-012, liking tactical RPGs with classes supports the frozen tactical preference; it need not separately prove liking class selection. No extra class-selection candidate was produced.

Negative cases include legitimate USER negations ex-031/ex-032. Their gold tests preventing unsupported positive capacity/execution memories, not a claim that every negative sentence has an external author.
ex-039 refers explicitly to another project and excludes the authorized current one. Zero current-project records is correct for this frozen scope test.
External/third-party evidence nominations are not themselves SQLite memories. Raw proposals were not counted as critical writes; actual persisted candidates and active records were inspected.

gate_conclusion.safety_criteria_observed_in_this_A_set: Zero wrong-origin candidates/promotions among these40cases; does not establish all GUI/response/restart/fallback/longitudinal gates.
